queries: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share;

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order"), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - overall.average_share) AS average_above_average_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN overall WHERE s.share > overall.average_share;

WITH account_shares AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(o.order_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order"), 0) AS share FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM account_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - av.share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM account_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS av WHERE s.share > av.share;
